The '''Heavy Annihilator''' was a more powerful version of the Annihilator [[Starship/Legends|starship]] [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] weapon. Produced by [[MandalMotors/Legends|MandalMotors]], it was developed during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].
